final_prompt:
A small soldering-cap robot is routing copper traces from a central hub chip outward to four sub-board quadrants on a large green PCB. The robot has a round silver cap head with a single small amber LED indicator, a tiny green PCB body, and small jointed arms holding signal probes. No eyes, no face, no humanoid expression. The robot stands at the center, actively touching the hub chip with both hands. It is actively working, NOT standing or leaning.

The PCB surface is green solder-mask with gold-copper traces, silver solder joints, and visible 3D depth. A large central black hub chip sits in the middle. Four copper traces fan outward from the hub to four quadrant sub-boards: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each sub-board is a small green rectangle with tiny chips on it. The top-right sub-board has three small chip rectangles in a row, with the center one highlighted with warm amber accent. The bottom-right sub-board also has three small chip rectangles, with one highlighted with a red LED indicator. The focal point is the central hub chip with the robot. Quiet zones around the outer edges.

A copper nameplate on the board reads '招聘公平审计官'.

Mandatory Chinese labels, each silkscreen-printed on its component:
- 招聘公平审计官 on the central hub nameplate
- 方案文档 on the top-left sub-board
- 分析引擎 on the top-right sub-board
- Demo数据 on the bottom-right sub-board
- 搭建指南 on the bottom-left sub-board
- 核心 on the amber-highlighted center chip in the top-right sub-board

Each label appears ONLY ONCE. Do NOT render as background text.

Clean editorial composition, generous margins. No flat schematic, no cartoon eyes, no humanoid face, no mascot sticker, no fake dense text, no stock PPT icons. Editorial, tactile, publish-grade, 16:9 horizontal.
qa_risks: chinese_labels: all 6 labels visible and attached to components
swap_test: image locked to 招聘公平审计官 project structure via nameplate
